mode.description: Which reels to show: day, hour, minute and AM or PM; month, day and year; or time only.

value.description: Controlled value. When it changes from outside, every reel spins to it along the short way around.

defaultValue.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Pass a fixed date so the first render matches on server and client.

onChange.description: Called once when the reels come to rest on a new moment, not on every frame.

today.description: Start of today, used for the Today entry and relative words such as Tomorrow or In 12 days. Pass new Date() after mount in an app.

minDate.description: Earliest selectable day. The day and year reels stop here with a rubber band.

minuteStep.description: Minutes between entries on the minute reel.

hourCycle.description: 12 hour clock with an AM or PM reel, or a 24 hour clock.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for day and month names, the time format, the AM and PM words and relative phrases.

presets.description: Quick picks under the reels. Choosing one spins every reel to it with a small stagger. The chip that matches the current value is marked pressed. false hides them.

title.description: Optional heading above the summary, such as "Send later".

onConfirm.description: Adds a primary button. Return a promise to show pending, success and failure in place without changing its width.

labels.description: Words for localization: reel names (day, month, date, year, hour, minute, period), the at joiner, the quick picks group name and the confirm button states.

intro.description: Spins the reels into place, one after another, the first time the picker scrolls into view.

speed.description: Multiplies the speed of glides, snaps and the intro.

paused.description: Stops automatic motion. Reels still follow a drag and land on the nearest entry at once.

accent.description: Any CSS color for the active reel in the lens and the chosen quick pick. Defaults to the theme accent.

label.description: Accessible name of the picker group.

style.description: Inline styles on the root element.
